text:
Asha: pet parade Monday! here's Basil the hamster practicing his tiny sprint for the snack bowl. pic: https://i.imgur.com/basil_run.jpg :hamster:
Marco: that is peak athleticism. small treadmill sponsorship pending :trophy:
Lina: caption: 'When you realize the snack drawer is a trap' :joy: also sending Basil a tiny victory flag
Drew: dropping dog tax: Noodle did a perfect office-chair-salute this weekend. pic: https://i.imgur.com/noodle_salute.jpg :dog2:
OpsBot: reminder: Office Pets require a signed Pet Waiver and vaccination upload at https://hr.internal/pet-waiver before bringing animals onsite. :memo:
Asha: signed the waiver this morning. Basil is up-to-date on wheel cardio and tiny chew approvals :white_check_mark:
Marco: poll: who wants a micro-obstacle course during Thursday lunchbreak? react :rocket: for yes, :thinking_face: for maybe
Lina: yes please, will bring tiny cones and a finish-line ribbon
Drew: maybe (but also will bring treats so it's definitely yes) :cookie:
Asha: event idea: micro-hamster Olympiad. categories: fastest lap, best tumble, most dramatic flop. prizes: bragging rights and ham-friendly snack pack
Marco: "most dramatic flop" already won by Basil in my heart
Lina: Noodle volunteers as cheer squad. also someone make a Basil emoji pls :paw_prints:
Drew: caption contest: 'When you open the laptop and your pup opens your heart' winner gets to pick the playlist for Thursday lunch :musical_note:
Asha: these threads cure midweek blues. thank you team. Basil will accept applause and tiny veggie slices :green_salad:
